arms.poe@0.3 / poe@0.5 / poe@0.7: the phase codes with policy-share floor lambda
arms.poenopol@0.5: the no-policy control: the prototype product alone on the arm dims
arms.poeopt@0.5: the codes without their prototypes (policy experts only)

metrics.codes: experiments/q3_build.py on demo 0 of each task (results/robot/poe_codes/<task>_d0.json)
metrics.episodes: 10 per arm and task, practice init states 0-9
metrics.go_rule: go to the pre-registered main read with the lambda >= 0.5 arm of highest pooled success if at least 3 of the 6 tasks gain >= 3/10 over zero-shot at that lambda; success only at lambda = 0.3 (sensitivity < 0.3) or with the no-policy control matching ours (within 2 of 60) = the policy is bypassed -> stop
metrics.p0_outcome: KILL fired (ledger q0_share): an early prototype weight moves the output by 0.38 of ||q - a_pi|| even with the policy alone at the last three steps (limit 0.2); the last step does not set the policy's share alone
metrics.p2_outcome: passes (ledger q2_explain): options cut the fit NLL by 0.57; the demo-0 code beats the policy on demo 1 in 21 of 21 tasks (by rms 15 of 21 with prototypes, 19 of 21 options only); recomputed options beat frozen ones in only 10 of 21
metrics.revision: one CONSTANT expert weight over all Euler steps; the policy family's share is a FLOOR lambda on every action dim (lifelong_ood/policy/poe.make_beta), the gripper from the policy family; the selected prototypes enter as Wang's precision-weighted product (poe.proto_product), and only prototypes reached FROM the demo phase are candidates (poe.query_nodes); experts are mixed in velocity space (a one-hot weight is the policy exactly); observation sensitivity at a constant prototype weight w (P0): w 0.5 -> 0.33, so lambda >= 0.5 keeps it >= 0.3
